places.quote: This was Little Dorrit’s party. The shame, desertion, wretchedness, and exposure of the great capital;
places.note: Identified as London by the phrase 'the great capital'.

places.quote: Born, Marshalsea Prison, Parish of St George.
places.note: Birthplace and long-term residence of Little Dorrit; not where the action takes place.

places.normalized: St George the Martyr church, Borough High Street, Southwark, London
places.quote: Going round by the Church, she saw lights there, and the door open;
places.note: Identified only by the parish of St George named in the register; the church is inferred, not named outright.
